text:
maria: FYI opened a docs PR to introduce the new 'burst allowance' header and update SDK snippets for quota-aware clients. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 :eyes:

aj: Thanks — main ask: can you add a one-line Go example? lots of customers use the Go client.

maria: added minimal Go + Python snippets in the PR, see code block below for Go:

```go
// set a burst allowance when you expect short spikes
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Burst-Allowance", "500")
resp, err := client.Do(req)
```

aj: Nice. Can we also show the new response header that indicates remaining allowance? e.g., `X-Redwood-Burst-Remaining` so SDKs can surface it.

maria: good call — added `X-Redwood-Burst-Remaining` example and a short migration note for Dedicated customers who currently parse `X-Quota-Remaining`. The note explains mapping and backwards compat: servers emit both for 30 days.

kevin: For Dedicated: we need the clear rollout plan in the PR description — who to contact for infra changes and the opt-out flag. Also confirm the header is present on websocket streams too.

maria: added rollout checklist: (1) infra owners to flip featureflag `burst_headers` in staging, (2) smoke test on a quiet tenant, (3) enable in prod for pilot tenants. Websocket streams will include the header in the initial handshake meta — added a short code snip for JS ws clients.

sara-ux: Small copy nit for dashboards: in the Usage > Quotas panel, change label from "Burst" to "Burst allowance (tokens)" so it's explicit. Can you update the docs screenshots and add a tooltip note?

maria: will update screenshots. I included alt text and a tooltip suggestion: "Burst allowance: short-term token credit that doesn't affect long-term quota tiers."

ben-platform: Test plan suggestion: add an integration test in docs integration harness that simulates burst use and asserts the `X-Redwood-Burst-Remaining` header decreases. Also add a unit test in the Go SDK example to parse header safely. We should gate doc build behind the feature flag in staging preview.

maria: added tests and updated the docs CI matrix to include `BURST_HEADERS=true` preview job. Also added an explicit section in migration guide for partners using old meter semantics.

docs-preview-bot: Docs PR preview ready: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/4521 — screenshots and snippets rendered.

aj: quick nit: in the Python snippet you use `requests.Session()` but don't show close. minor but tidy it up.

maria: fixed python snippet, pushed.

aj: :+1: from me after the tidy. Kept it short since this is mostly docs + small API notice.

kevin: I'll coordinate the infra flip for staging tomorrow morning and ping infra owners. :shipit:

maria: thanks all — unless any major objections I'll merge after a 24h review. If you want to test manually, steps are in PR description under "Manual test":
1) staging tenant with `BURST_HEADERS` enabled
2) run `curl -i -H "X-Redwood-Burst-Allowance: 800" https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
3) verify response header `X-Redwood-Burst-Remaining` decreases on subsequent requests

maria: cc @ben-platform for the integration test run and @sara-ux for dashboard screenshot once updated.
